description: Adaptive Power Distribution for High-Density AI Data Centers under GPU Load Surges via Digital Twin Validation is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors xiang. Sudden and synchronized graphics processing unit (GPU) load surges in high-density artificial intelligence (AI) data centers frequently cause direct current (DC) bus voltage deviations, excessive power supply unit (PSU) loading, and accelerated uninterruptible power supply (UPS) degradation. To address these critical power quality challenges, this study presents a predictive, digital-twin-enabled architecture for rack-level power coordination. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
